title: Yellow Spicy Russian Chicken Stew
description: A savory and energizing Russian dish featuring makrut lime leaves, this stew is perfect for a cold winter's night. It is keto-friendly and can be cooked in a hot pot vessel.
instructions: In a large hot pot vessel, combine chicken broth, heavy cream, makrut lime leaves, dried dill weed, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped fresh herbs, if using.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional makrut lime leaves if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze the stew for later use.
Reheat the stew over low heat, stirring occasionally.
